messages:
alex: heads up — after the 03:00 BMC fw rollout in eu1, ~30 nodes flipped secureboot=on and the BMC watchdog forced reboots. GPUs were evicted, pods rescheduled, autoscaler overshot and cost alerter triggered. filing thread to coordinate.

maya: seeing the same in monitoring. node eviction logs show `secure_boot_toggle: true` and `bmc-watchdog: reboot-triggered`.

devon: @alex which image id rolled? can we revert to previous stable?

alex: deploy-bot reported image `bmc-fw-2026-03-08-rc4` — rollout id 3345. deploy-bot: rollout completed.

deploy-bot: rollout 3345 completed at 2026-03-08T03:00Z (canary passed)

katie: metric update: we've lost ~120 GPUs in eu1 (evicted/unavailable). autoscaler spun up ~80 in us-west to keep queues, cost alert: est +$6.2k/hr. finance pinged.

ops-sre: oncall taking lead — starting containment. I'll cordon/draint the affected nodes so they stop getting scheduled and we can reprovision. runbook: https://runbooks.internal/oob-bmc-rollback

devon: before reprovisioning, try `ipmitool mc reset warm` on a node in rack-14 — last time that cleared a stuck watchdog without full image reflash.

alex: pulled a raw log from a node that flapped: 
```
Mar 08 03:02 bmc: secure_boot toggled by fw_upgrade
Mar 08 03:02 watchdog: reboot scheduled in 30s
kernel: nvme0: I/O error, device lost
systemd: kubelet: NodeNotReady -> eviction
```

maya: question — can we temporarily raise the watchdog timeout so transient toggles don't force reboots until we have a rollback?

ops-sre: applying a temporary guard now: bumping `watchdog.timeout` to 120s via bmc-ctl on the fleet. rolling to 50 hosts first.

ops-sre: update — applied to first 50 hosts, prevented immediate reboots on 42 of them, 8 still rebooted during the flash window. continuing.

katie: finance update: if we don't contain within 2 hours, projection is ~+$28.5k extra spend for the day due to cross-region scaling and reprovisioning. raising an S1 cost blip.

alex: decision: pause remaining fw jobs in eu1 and eu2, start coordinated rollback to last stable. @deploy-bot please pause rollouts in eu1/eu2.

deploy-bot: pausing rollouts in eu1 and eu2 — acknowledged.

devon: rollback plan: revert to `bmc-fw-2026-03-03-stable` on a 3-node canary with manual observation for 1 hour, then staged batches. manual preflight to verify `secure_boot_flag` unchanged after flash.

maya: also adding a CI preflight that queries `ipmitool sdr` and `ipmitool sel elist` post-flash and fails the job if secure_boot bit toggles.

alex: I'll open the postmortem and tag firmware-team + release-engineering. schedule maintenance window for next Tue 03:00 UTC to reattempt with extra checks. thanks all :thumbsup:
